title: セントライト記念の後に・昇竜と伏龍

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black sails straight through the St. Lite Kinen. There was absolutely no need to be concerned about the race's distance after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond also stops by and informs her that she will soon make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Kikuka Sho, but her greatest rival, Brusquement, will not be running in it because she has to undergo minor surgery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, Kitasan Black's main source of motivation is gone. Unfortunately, race day is coming up fast.
